name: Static Gust
description: Throw a gust charged with static that bites the target's skin and makes the hair stand.

name: Charged Step
description: Step on a charged draft that cracks underfoot and flings the user a long pace aside.

name: Spark Screen
description: Hold a screen of moving air that sparks and bites any hand that strikes it.

name: Crackle Lash
description: Lash a crackling cord of charged air that stings the target at a distance.

name: Ozone Sense
description: Smell the ozone in the air and read where charge gathers and where a bolt may fall.

name: Sparking Draft
description: Send a sparking draft along the foe's arm so the muscles jump and the grip is lost.

name: Charged Lungs
description: Draw a charged breath through the chest to quicken the user's reflexes for some moments.

name: Arc Squall
description: Call a squall that throws arcs of charged air among the foes and jolts each one it touches.

name: Veering Arc
description: Veer along a bending arc of charged wind and strike the foe at the end of the curve.

name: Thunderhead Cyclone
description: Raise a cyclone crowned with a thunderhead that scatters charged wind over the whole field.

name: Bolt Cyclone
description: streams: Wind + Lightning; spin a cyclone around a core of lightning so that every turn throws bolts into the foes.

name: Ember Gust
description: Fling a gust carrying hot embers that sting the target's skin and singe its cloth.

name: Warm Glide
description: Glide on a rising warm draft that lifts the user lightly over a short gap.

name: Haze Screen
description: Hold a screen of shimmering hot air that turns aside blows and blurs the user's outline.

name: Smoke Reading
description: Read how smoke bends in the wind and learn where bodies and drafts move among the flames.

name: Kindling Draft
description: Blow a hot draft onto a foe's clothing so it must beat out the flame instead of striking.

name: Cinder Lash
description: Lash a stream of glowing cinders on a gust at the foe's face.

name: Hot Breath
description: Breathe in a hot draft and let its fire quicken the user's blood and qi.

name: Flame Fan
description: Sweep the arms wide and fan a sheet of flame across the foes before the user.

name: Fanned Blaze
description: Fan a blaze into a roaring gale of fire that scorches every foe in a broad arc.

name: Hot Updraft
description: Surge upward on a column of hot air and drop onto the foe wrapped in heat.

name: Blaze Vortex
description: Spin a vortex of burning air that draws in foes and scorches them as it turns.

name: Searing Cyclone
description: streams: Wind + Fire; drive a cyclone of white flame across the field that feeds on its own gale.

name: Thunder Palm
description: Clap the palms and loose a booming gust that shakes the target's chest.

name: Static Glide
description: Glide on a charged film of air that sets the hair on the arms on end.

name: Charge Screen
description: Hold a screen of charged air that flashes where a blow lands and sheds its force.

name: Storm Reading
description: Read the heavy air for rising storm and judge how far the next flash will fall.

name: Rumble Lash
description: Lash a rumbling cord of wind and charge that jolts the target from afar.

name: Flicker Cut
description: Flicker a thin charged blade across the foe's guard so the muscles of the arm seize.

name: Static Surge
description: Surge charged qi along the limbs and speed the user's reactions for a burst of effort.

name: Crackling Draft
description: Blow a crackling draft across a foe's weapon hand and make the fingers jump and open.

name: Thunder Squall
description: Call down a squall of thunder that shakes and shocks every foe within its field.

name: Storm Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of charged wind that blunts blows and shocks the hand that strikes it.

name: Stormcore Vortex
description: Spin a vortex from the stormcore that grinds the foes and breaks their holds with thunder.

name: Rending Stormfront
description: streams: Wind + Lightning; drive a front of charged wind and bolts across the field and rend all before it.

name: Ash Gust
description: Throw a gust thick with hot ash that blinds and burns the target's face.

name: Cinder Glide
description: Glide away on a trail of glowing cinders carried in a hot low draft.

name: Scorch Screen
description: Hold a scorching screen of wind that burns what touches it and slows what it cannot burn.

name: Ember Reading
description: Read the glow and drift of embers and learn which way the fire and the wind will turn.

name: Burning Draft
description: Blow a burning draft across a foe's guard and force it to give ground.

name: Flare Lash
description: Lash a bright flaring cord of flame on the wind at a distant foe.

name: Hearth Breath
description: Draw a warm breath from the core's hearth and let it stoke the user's qi.

name: Billowing Flame
description: Billow a wide sheet of flame forward on a strong gust that scorches foes in a broad arc.

name: Furnace Gale
description: Blow a gale hot as a furnace across the field and sear every foe it reaches.

name: Pyre Squall
description: Call a burning squall over the foes that scatters their ranks and sets their gear alight.

name: Roaring Mantle
description: Wrap the body in a roaring mantle of fire and wind that burns those who strike it.

name: Hearthfire Vortex
description: Spin a vortex of fire drawn from the core's hearth that burns and drags in all near it.

name: Conflagration Cyclone
description: streams: Wind + Fire; raise a cyclone of core fire and wind that burns an entire field to ash.
